description: 'රට' (country) is codemix_plausible=true; 'කතා' (talk) is an eligible word-bank entry but codemix_plausible=false (the LLM translator judged 'talk' as not a word a bilingual speaker would actually code-mix in). At light severity (k=1), the pool must prefer the plausible word — 'රට' must be the one substituted, for EVERY seed, never 'කතා', since selection only falls back to implausible words when NOTHING plausible is available (see src/noisers/codemix.py's `pool = plausible if plausible else eligible`).
